policy.source: Derived from payload_slices.godot_owner and canonical source_api_contracts.

PortGame.source_build_payload_write_stat.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_write_state pins BuildPayload.write(Writes write) write-call order contract.

PortGame.source_build_payload_set_state.source_method: BuildPayload.set(float x, float y, float rotation)
PortGame.source_build_payload_set_state.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_set_state pins BuildPayload.set(float x, float y, float rotation) set-call contract.

PortGame.source_build_payload_draw_shado.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_draw_shadow_state pins BuildPayload.drawShadow(float alpha) square-shadow call contract.

PortGame.source_build_payload_draw_state.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_draw_state pins BuildPayload.draw() ordered draw operation contract.

PortGame.source_build_payload_place_stat.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_place_state pins BuildPayload.place(Tile,int) setBlock and dropped side-effect contract.

PortGame.source_build_payload_update_sta.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_update_state pins BuildPayload.update guard and delegate contract.

PortGame.source_build_payload_destroyed_.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_destroyed_state pins BuildPayload.destroyed dead assignment and onDestroyed delegate contract.

PortGame.source_build_payload_constructo.rule: PortGame.source_build_payload_constructor_block_team_state pins BuildPayload(Block, Team) build creation and emptyTile assignment contract.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_constructor.rule: PortGame.source_unit_payload_constructor_state pins UnitPayload(Unit) direct unit assignment contract.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_update_stat.rule: PortGame.source_unit_payload_update_state pins UnitPayload.update(@Nullable Unit unitHolder, @Nullable Building buildingHolder) delegate contract.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_write_state.rule: PortGame.source_unit_payload_write_state pins UnitPayload.write(Writes write) write-call order contract.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_set_state.source_method: UnitPayload.set(float x, float y, float rotation)
PortGame.source_unit_payload_set_state.rule: PortGame.source_unit_payload_set_state pins UnitPayload.set(float x, float y, float rotation) state contract.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_x_state.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_x_state mirrors UnitPayload.x().

PortGame.source_unit_payload_y_state.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_y_state mirrors UnitPayload.y().

PortGame.source_unit_payload_size_state.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_size_state mirrors UnitPayload.size().

PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_type_n.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_type_null_guard_state mirrors UnitPayload.dump() unit.type null guard and defers remaining branches.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_can_cr.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_can_create_guard_state mirrors UnitPayload.dump() type-null and canCreate guard order, deferring remaining dump branches.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_solidi.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_solidity_guard_state mirrors UnitPayload.dump() solidity guard order and tile probe, deferring remaining dump branches.

params.java_expr: Units.count(unit.x, unit.y, unit.physicSize() * 1.05f, o -> o.isGrounded() && (o.type.allowLegStep == unit.type.allowLegStep))
params.name: units_count

PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_overla.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_overlap_guard_state mirrors UnitPayload.dump() overlap guard order and Units.count short-circuit, deferring remaining dump branches.

params.java_expr: Units.count(unit.x, unit.y, unit.physicSize() * 1.05f, o -> o.isGrounded() && (o.type.allowLegStep == unit.type.allowLegStep))
params.name: units_count

PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_no_cli.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_no_client_guard_state mirrors UnitPayload.dump() no-client guard order, deferring stacking/spawn side effects.

params.java_expr: Units.count(unit.x, unit.y, unit.physicSize() * 1.05f, o -> o.isGrounded() && (o.type.allowLegStep == unit.type.allowLegStep))
params.name: units_count

PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_spawn_.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_dump_spawn_side_effects_state mirrors UnitPayload.dump() spawn side effects after all guards pass.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_shadow.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_shadow_type_null_state mirrors UnitPayload.drawShadow(float alpha) guard and drawSoftShadow call record.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_type_n.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_type_null_state mirrors UnitPayload.draw() type-null guard and defers the remaining draw body.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_elevat.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_elevation_setup_state mirrors UnitPayload.draw() elevation setup after the type-null guard.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_overla.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_draw_overlay_warning_state mirrors UnitPayload.draw() overlay warning branch after elevation setup.

PortGame.source_unit_payload_icon_state.rule: Dictionary returned by PortGame.source_unit_payload_icon_state mirrors UnitPayload.icon().

PortGame.source_block_producer_build_upd.rule: PortGame.source_block_producer_build_update_tile_progress_accumulation_state pins progress += buildSpeed * edelta() behind produce guard.
PortGame.source_block_producer_build_update_tile_payload_creation_state pins new BuildPayload(recipe, team) and placeEffect.at(x, y, payload.size() / tilesize).
PortGame.source_block_producer_build_update_tile_heat_time_state pins heat = Mathf.lerpDelta(heat, Mathf.num(produce), 0.15f); and time += heat * delta();.
PortGame.source_block_producer_build_update_tile_move_out_payload_state pins moveOutPayload() and PayloadBlockBuild.moveOutPayload() movement gates from source.
